title: The Week Andela Ended Its Junior Developer Programme
conflicts: Layoff number: 400 (Johnson to TechCrunch; TechCabal November 2019) vs about 420 (250 in Nigeria and Uganda plus about 170 in Kenya, Andela to TechCabal; TechCabal May 2020); both given with who said what. Hiring plan: 500 more developers next year (Johnson to TechCrunch) vs 700 senior developers by end of 2020 (TechCabal); both given. Headcount 1,575 before (August 2019) vs about 1,200 later (TechCabal November 2019, TechCrunch July 2020) vs over 1,300 on a May 2020 call; story uses 1,575 and the July 2020 figure. Junior commitment two years (TechCrunch) vs four-year agreement (TechCabal); story says only 'for years'.
notes: The slate's 'trainees' is corrected to salaried junior developers, as the sources describe them. Founder field is Jeremy Johnson alone (co-founders named in the sources vary between four and six people). Stance 'challenges': Ben Sira on not dealing badly with the hired worker who gives his life, set beside the layoffs. Quartz (Seni Sulyman interview) blocks automated requests, so his remarks are taken from TechCabal's report of them.
